title: Sougou Kakutougi - Astral Bout 2 - The Total Fighters
aliases: Sougou Kakutougi: Astral Bout 2: The Total Fighters
description: A mixed martial arts fighting game for the Super Famicom, developed by A-Wave and published by King Records, released in Japan in 1994. It is the second of three Astral Bout games.
